item.title: Frasers Group to snap up majority shareholding in Maxi Sport
item.description: Frasers Group is set to acquire a majority shareholding in Italian sportswear retailer Maxi Sport SpA.

item.title: WHSmith launches new sites at Manchester and Liverpool airports
item.description: WHSmith has opened three new sites across Manchester Airport and Liverpool John Lennon Airport this week, marking its continued investment in travel hubs across the North of the UK.

item.title: Quiz Clothing collapses into administration as online store closes
item.description: Quiz Clothing has entered administration, with its online store closing and more than 100 redundancies confirmed following a tough Christmas trading period.

item.title: Lidl unveils seventh pay rise since 2023
item.description: Lidl GB has unveiled a further £29m investment in staff pay, which it claimed would “once again” make it the highest paying UK supermarket.
